meta.name: Bouma Detective 720p
meta.description:
Simple homemaker Rohini decides to take on the role of a detective, after her superstar husband Ranojay is accused of murdering of his co-actor.

Returning Series · First aired 3 Dec 2017 · India · Language: Bengali · 166 min
Studio: Hoichoi · Network: hoichoi

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9

On your server — Audio: Bengali

videos.title: Lights-Camera-Murder
videos.overview: Rohini’s life is mundane unlike the glitzy world of her superstar husband’s. He enjoys the over-the-top life, until a murder shakes their world altogether.

videos.title: Bouma Ebar Goyenda
videos.overview: With the accusation tagging along with Ranojay's celebrity image, Rohini takes the decision to solve the mystery and is determined to prove her husband's innocence.

videos.title: Whodunnit
videos.overview: The detective in Rohini suspects Rano is wrongly charged with the murder. She teams up with Atanu, Ranojay's secretary only to secretly carry out her actions.

videos.title: Bish-Sutro
videos.overview: Rohini probes deep into the case in guise and gets hold of certain evidence that is suspected to be the weapon used in actress Abheri's murder.

videos.title: Abar Khun
videos.overview: As she tries to join the dots based on her investigative approach, Rohini reaches Pamela's apartment to find her dead, with the prime suspect - Ranojay.

videos.title: Makeup Room Diary
videos.overview: Rohini gets a call from Nipa, Pamela's attendant, who tells her that director Samriddha's car was parked in front of Pamela's place the day she died.

videos.title: Shesher Shuru
videos.overview: With all the accumulated information, Rohini decides to proceed with the final round of her investigation, by asking the police force to help her.

videos.title: Mukhosh Manush
videos.overview: The high profile murder's take a new turn, but Rohini feels she is at the verge of cracking the case along with the help of the Police.

videos.title: All For Love
videos.overview: Ranojay goes from being a starlet to a caring husband while homemaker Rohini turns into a successful detective, thus mending the relationship between the two.
